lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is the San Miguel County BOCC's special meeting Wednesday, where they'll consider changing the Area Median Income limits on deed-restricted properties at Pinion Park — a technical-sounding move that directly shapes who qualifies for affordable housing in this valley. Also Wednesday, the County Planning Commission takes up three Land Use Code amendments touching forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy. Over in Ridgway Tuesday, Town Council is ratifying letters tied to the Gold Mountain Fire disaster declaration, a reminder that the region is still deep in that crisis.

notable.stake: Council ratifies disaster declaration support for Gold Mountain Fire communities.
